body: Gurdeep Soni (Chairman & MD) on the Q1FY26 call (2025-08-11), volunteered: "We expect the segment to grow further in mid-teens in FY '26" Metric: Aftermarket revenue FY26 YoY. Target: ~+15%. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (fiscal-year). Specificity: range. Status as of 2026-11-19: MOVED-GOALPOST. Evidence: Cut to 'single digit' growth 3 months later (Chairman, 2025-11-17) without calling it a cut. The 9M FY26 aftermarket share then fell to 14% from 19% (analyst figure, not disputed by the CEO on 2026-02-10), which implies roughly -14% YoY (~INR 116 cr vs ~INR 135 cr). No FY26 figure was disclosed; by May-2026 it was called a 'stable contributor'. Q1FY27 call (CEO, 2026-08-05): aftermarket 'went from 20% [of revenue] in FY25 to 15% in FY26', i.e. ~INR 193 cr -> ~INR 175 cr, about -9% YoY (re-derived). Management explanation: Higher inventory at European aftermarket customers; US tariff sensitivity (given only when asked).
